arxiv-2109-12586.title: Simulation of Separable Quantum Measurements on Bipartite States via Likelihood POVMs
arxiv-2109-12586.creator: Arun Padakandla
arxiv-2109-12586.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Arun Padakandla. By developing a new framework of likelihood POVMs, analysis techniques and a new proof of the quantum covering lemma, we address the simulation of separable quantum measurement over bipartite states. In addition to a new one shot inner bound that naturally generalizes to the asymptotic case, we demonstrate the power, generality and universality of the developed techniques in the most general distributed measurement scenario by recovering all current known inner bounds.

arxiv-2208-13842.title: Fast protein folding is governed by memory-dependent friction
arxiv-2208-13842.creator: Benjamin A. Dalton, Cihan Ayaz, Lucas Tepper, Roland R. Netz
arxiv-2208-13842.description: Abstract When described by a low-dimensional reaction coordinate, the rates of protein folding are determined by a subtle interplay between free-energy barriers and friction. While it is commonplace to extract free-energy profiles from molecular trajectories, a direct evaluation of friction is far more elusive, and one typically evaluates it indirectly via memoryless reaction rate theories.

arxiv-2303-05829.title: Anomalous Hall effect in type-I Weyl metals beyond the noncrossing approximation
arxiv-2303-05829.creator: Jia-Xing Zhang 1, Wei Chen 1,2
arxiv-2303-05829.description: Abstract We study the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) in tilted Weyl metals with Gaussian disorder due to the crossed X X and Ψ \Psi diagrams in this work. The importance of such diagrams to the AHE has been demonstrated recently in two dimensional (2D) massive Dirac model and Rashba ferromagnets.

arxiv-2308-09817.title: Accelerating force calculation for dislocation dynamics simulations
arxiv-2308-09817.creator: Rasool Ahmad, Wei Cai
arxiv-2308-09817.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Rasool Ahmad, Wei Cai. Discrete dislocation dynamics (DDD) simulations offer valuable insights into the plastic deformation and work-hardening behavior of metals by explicitly modeling the evolution of dislocation lines under stress. However, the computational cost associated with calculating forces due to the long-range elastic interactions between dislocation segment pairs is one of the main causes that limit the achievable strain levels in DDD simulations.

arxiv-2501-14702.title: Multiparty Session Types with a Bang!
arxiv-2501-14702.creator: Matthew Alan Le Brun, Simon Fowler, Ornela Dardha
arxiv-2501-14702.description: Abstract Replication is an alternative construct to recursion for describing infinite behaviours in the π \pi -calculus. In this paper we explore the implications of including type-level replication in Multiparty Session Types (MPST) , a behavioural type theory for message-passing programs. We introduce MPST! , a session-typed multiparty process calculus with replication and first-class roles.

pmc-10698898.creator: Chaoshi Qin, Tingting Wang, Ni Qian, Jing Liu, Rong Xi, Qing Zou, Hui Liu, Xiaolin Niu
pmc-10698898.description: Background( −)-Epigallocatechin-3-gallate (EGCG), a bioactive polyphenol isolated from green tea, has recently garnered attention for its potential protective role against acute myocardial infarction (MI) via inhibiting inflammation. Herein, we tested whether EGCG participates in modulating cardiac ischemia reperfusion-induced injury and elucidate its potential mechanisms.

pmc-11357585.title: Prevalence of Drugs of Abuse and Cognitive Enhancer Consumption Monitored in Grab Samples and Composite Wastewater via Orbitrap Mass Spectrometry Analysis
pmc-11357585.creator: Fabian Frankenfeld, Lea Wagmann, Cathy M Jacobs, Markus R Meyer, Yannis Dotsikas
pmc-11357585.description: Wastewater (WW)-based epidemiology is an approach for the objective surveillance of the consumption of (illicit) drugs in populations. The aims of this study were to monitor drugs of abuse, cognitive enhancers, and their metabolites as biomarkers in influent WW. Data obtained from different sampling points and mean daily loads were compared with previously published data.

pmc-12386658.creator: Sonia Zhan-Dai, Blanca Grases-Pintó, Adriana García-Vara, Ruth Ferrer, Raquel Martín-Venegas, Rosa M Lamuela-Raventós, Margarida Castell, Francisco J Pérez-Cano, Anna Vallverdú-Queralt, Maria J Rodríguez-Lagunas, Antonio Arnaiz-Villena
pmc-12386658.description: Maternal diet influences offspring development, immune function, and intestinal health. This study investigates the effects of maternal supplementation with a key component of the Mediterranean Diet, extra virgin olive oil (EVOO), on the immune health of offspring at the end of lactation. Lewis rat dams received either refined olive oil (ROO), EVOO, or water (REF) during gestation and lactation.

pmc-12427030.creator: Zhilin Yang, Peiliang Zhang, Tiejun Zhang, Jianchun Yin, Guanglun Zhou, Weiguang Zhao, Pengyu Chen, Jiaqiang Li, Shoulin Li
pmc-12427030.description: PurposeTo resolve conflicting evidence on androgen receptor (AR) expression in hypospadias, we compared preputial AR levels between affected children and controls.MethodsForty patients with isolated hypospadias (age 2.9 ± 0.79 years, range 1.6–5.2 years) and 40 normal boys (age 3.2 ± 0.79 years, range 1.8–4.7 years) who underwent circumcision for phimosis were included in our study.

pmc-12430067.title: An Elastoplastic Constitutive Model for Steel Slag Aggregate Concrete Under Multiaxial Stress States Based on Non-Uniform Hardening Theory
pmc-12430067.creator: Zhijun Chen, Liang Huang, Yiwei Yang, Teng Dong
pmc-12430067.description: Steel slag aggregate concrete (SAC) is widely recognized as a high-performance and sustainable construction material. However, its broader structural application has been impeded by the limited development of reliable constitutive models. Building upon the well-established non-uniform hardening plasticity theory, this study proposes a comprehensive theoretical framework to establish a stress–strain relationship model for SAC under complex stress states.

pmc-12589932.description: Small photosynthetic eukaryotes are a productive and dynamic component of marine planktonic communities. uslaw-usc-t12-s376.title: 12 U.S.C. § 376 — Rate of interest paid to directors, etc.
uslaw-usc-t12-s376.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s376.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 3 (Federal Reserve System); Subchapter X (Powers And Duties Of Member Banks). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. No member bank shall pay to any director, officer, attorney, or employee a greater rate of interest on the deposits of such director, officer, attorney, or employee than that paid to other depositors on similar deposits.
